title: Four games and editor controls for reading the final image

scenes.title: appearance-resident
lines: Start with Resident Evil, moving from a dark room to the rainy vehicle shot. Watch the turning face and wet clothing. The labelled On condition changes their surface appearance. Different poses are not a pixel-aligned ground truth.

scenes.title: exposure-context
lines: This is a2017 Unreal editor demonstration. Separate the cube arrangement from the post-process controls on the right. Camera and parameters both change, so we first identify the edited inputs rather than attributing every brightness difference to one feature.

scenes.title: histogram-camera-condition
lines: Camera movement changes the proportions of surfaces in the image. Seeing more bright cubes can change the brightness distribution within the same lit scene. Exposure comparisons therefore need camera framing as well as settings. This is an observation demonstration, not a fixed-camera numerical experiment.

scenes.title: grade-to-lookup
lines: Record the edited input, the surface where a change appears and any simultaneous condition changes. Next we examine a separate color-transform resource, continuing the distinction between final displayed color and the original lighting value.
